summary.short: Brazilian bill (Senate-passed text) setting national rules for AI: bans excessive-risk uses, imposes rights, governance and impact-assessment duties for high-risk and general-purpose AI, requires remuneration for copyrighted training content, and creates an ANPD-coordinated supervisory system. Most provisions would apply 730 days after publication.
summary.long: PL 2338/2023, approved by the Senate on 10 December 2024 and pending in the Chamber of Deputies, would set national general rules for developing, deploying and using AI systems. It excludes private non-economic use, national defence, pre-market research and testing, and pure data infrastructure. It prohibits excessive-risk systems: harmful behavioural manipulation, crime-risk profiling, child sexual abuse material, public-authority social scoring, autonomous weapons, and real-time remote biometric identification in public spaces outside listed law-enforcement exceptions. For listed high-risk uses (critical infrastructure, education, employment, essential services, justice, health, emotion recognition, migration and others), developers and deployers must document, test, mitigate bias, ensure human oversight and carry out algorithmic impact assessments with public conclusions; affected persons gain rights to explanation, contestation and human review. General-purpose and generative AI developers must make preliminary risk assessments; those with systemic risk must document testing and publish training-data summaries. Developers must disclose and remunerate copyrighted content used, subject to a research mining exception and rightholder opt-out. The ANPD would coordinate a national system (SIA) of sectoral regulators. Fines reach R$50 million or 2% of group revenue in Brazil per infraction. Most rules apply 730 days after publication; prohibitions, general-purpose AI and copyright rules after 180 days.

territorial_scope.description: National general rules for AI systems developed, deployed or used in Brazil; binds federal, state and municipal public administration as well as private agents.

thresholds.variable_text: pena privativa de liberdade (maximum custodial sentence of the crime in flagrante delicto)
thresholds.measurement: Statutory custodial penalty for the crime being committed
thresholds.consequence: Real-time remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces is permitted for flagrante delicto of such crimes, as an exception to the Art. 13 ban
thresholds.conditions: Immediate communication to the judicial authority; use proportional and strictly necessary, under due process and judicial control (Art. 13 §2)

evidence.quote: flagrante delito de crimes punidos com pena privativa de liberdade superior a 2 (dois) anos, com imediata comunicação à autoridade judicial

thresholds.conditions: The firm promotes the development of the national technology industry; criteria consider competitive impact, number of affected users and nature of the activities

evidence.quote: As autoridades setoriais deverão proporcionar a micro e pequenas empresas, startups e Instituições Científica, Tecnológicas e de Inovação (ICTs) públicas e privadas acesso prioritário aos ambientes de testagem

obligations.summary: Development, implementation and use of excessive-risk AI systems is prohibited: harmful behavioural manipulation, exploitation of vulnerabilities, crime-risk assessment from personality or past behaviour, enabling child sexual abuse material, and autonomous weapons. Binds all agents (developers, distributors, deployers).

evidence.quote: São vedados o desenvolvimento, a implementação e o uso de sistemas de IA

obligations.summary: Public authorities may not use AI to evaluate, classify or rank people by social behaviour or personality through universal scoring for access to goods, services and public policies in an illegitimate or disproportionate way.

evidence.quote: pelo poder público, para avaliar, classificar ou ranquear as pessoas naturais, com base no seu comportamento social ou em atributos da sua personalidade, por meio de pontuação universal

obligations.summary: Real-time remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces is banned except for criminal investigations with prior judicial authorisation, searches for victims and missing persons or imminent threats to life, flagrante delicto of crimes punishable by over 2 years, and recapture of fugitives or execution of warrants; permitted use must be proportional, under judicial control, with review of the algorithmic inference by the responsible official.
obligations.conditional_on: One of the exceptions in Art. 13 IV a-d applies

evidence.quote: em sistemas de identificação biométrica à distância, em tempo real e em espaços acessíveis ao público, com exceção das seguintes hipóteses

obligations.summary: Developers must adopt measures to prevent their systems being used for the prohibited purposes of Art. 13.

evidence.quote: Os desenvolvedores de sistemas de IA devem adotar medidas para coibir o uso de seus sistemas para as hipóteses descritas no caput deste artigo.

obligations.summary: Persons affected by any AI system have a right to free, accessible information about their interactions with AI, including its automated nature, given with standardised icons or symbols (except cybersecurity and cyberdefence systems).

evidence.quote: direito à informação quanto às suas interações com sistemas de IA, de forma acessível, gratuita e de fácil compreensão, inclusive sobre caráter automatizado da interação

obligations.summary: AI systems intended for vulnerable groups must be transparent throughout their life cycle, use simple, age- and capacity-appropriate language and be implemented in those groups' best interest.

evidence.quote: Os sistemas de IA que se destinem a grupos vulneráveis deverão, em todas as etapas de seu ciclo de vida, ser transparentes e adotar linguagem simples, clara e apropriada à idade e à capacidade cognitiva

obligations.summary: Persons affected by high-risk AI have rights to an explanation of decisions, recommendations or predictions, to contest them and to human review; explanations must be free, in simple language and within a reasonable time, under procedures set by the competent authority (simplified for small firms).

evidence.quote: A pessoa ou grupo afetado por sistema de IA de alto risco tem os seguintes direitos: I – direito à explicação sobre a decisão, a recomendação ou a previsão feitas pelo sistema

obligations.summary: Agents of high-risk AI must inform affected persons, clearly and accessibly, of the procedures for exercising their rights.

evidence.quote: Os agentes de IA de alto risco informarão, de forma suficiente, objetiva, clara e acessível, os procedimentos necessários para o exercício dos direitos descritos neste Capítulo.

obligations.summary: High-risk AI systems must be subject to human oversight enabling responsible persons to understand, interpret, decide and intervene; where oversight is demonstrably impossible or disproportionate, effective alternative measures are required.

evidence.quote: A supervisão humana de sistemas de IA de alto risco buscará prevenir ou minimizar os riscos para direitos e liberdades das pessoas ou grupos afetados

obligations.summary: All AI agents (developers, distributors, deployers) must ensure the security of systems and respect for the rights of affected persons, as regulated.

evidence.quote: Os agentes de IA deverão garantir a segurança dos sistemas e o atendimento dos direitos de pessoas ou grupos afetados, nos termos de regulamento.

obligations.summary: Deployers placing high-risk systems on the market must keep life-cycle documentation, monitor outputs for accuracy, robustness and discriminatory results, document tests and the degree of human oversight, mitigate bias and provide information to interpret results.
obligations.conditional_on: Sectoral authorities may relax or waive these obligations depending on the agent's role in the value chain (Art. 18 §1)

evidence.quote: o desenvolvedor e o aplicador, ao introduzirem ou colocarem em circulação no mercado sistema de alto risco, adotarão, entre outras, as seguintes medidas de governança

obligations.summary: Developers of high-risk systems must keep records of governance measures for deployers, log system operation, test for safety, adopt technical measures for explainability, mitigate bias and be transparent about governance policies.
obligations.conditional_on: Sectoral authorities may relax or waive these obligations depending on the agent's role in the value chain (Art. 18 §1)

evidence.quote: manutenção de registro das medidas de governança adotadas no desenvolvimento do sistema de IA, para prestação das informações necessárias ao aplicador

obligations.summary: Distributors must support and verify that a high-risk AI system complies with the governance measures of the Law before it is placed on the market.

evidence.quote: Os distribuidores deverão apoiar e verificar se o sistema de IA cumpre as medidas de governança previstas nesta Lei, antes de o sistema ser colocado em circulação no mercado

obligations.summary: Agents in the AI value chain must cooperate, sharing information, technical access and assistance needed for high-risk governance obligations; a deployer or distributor that substantially modifies a system or changes its purpose is treated as its developer.

evidence.quote: Os agentes da cadeia de valor de sistema ou aplicação de IA devem cooperar entre si, disponibilizando as informações necessárias

obligations.summary: AI systems that generate synthetic content must embed an identifier allowing verification of authenticity, provenance, modification or transmission, considering the state of the art and context of use; artistic works may be labelled in credits or metadata.

evidence.quote: Quando o sistema de IA gerar conteúdo sintético, deverá, considerando o estado da arte do desenvolvimento tecnológico e o contexto de uso, incluir identificador em tais conteúdos

obligations.summary: The developer that places a high-risk AI system on the market must carry out an algorithmic impact assessment beforehand and update it periodically over the life cycle.
obligations.conditional_on: System or its use is high-risk; sectoral authority may relax the assessment (Art. 25 §4)

evidence.quote: A avaliação de impacto algorítmico de sistemas de IA é obrigação do desenvolvedor ou do aplicador que introduzir ou colocar sistema de IA em circulação no mercado, sempre que o sistema ou o seu uso forem de alto risco

obligations.summary: The deployer that places a high-risk AI system on the market must carry out an algorithmic impact assessment beforehand, according to its role in the chain, and update it periodically.
obligations.conditional_on: System or its use is high-risk; sectoral authority may relax the assessment (Art. 25 §4)

evidence.quote: A avaliação deverá ser realizada em momento prévio e de acordo com o contexto específico da introdução ou colocação em circulação no mercado do sistema de IA.

obligations.summary: Developers of high-risk AI must share their preliminary and algorithmic impact assessments with the sectoral authority.

evidence.quote: O desenvolvedor de sistema de IA de alto risco deverá, nos termos de regulamento, compartilhar com a autoridade setorial as avaliações preliminares e de impacto algorítmico

obligations.summary: Conclusions of algorithmic impact assessments must be made public, subject to trade secrets; the competent authority keeps a public database of high-risk AI impact assessments (Art. 44).

evidence.quote: As conclusões da avaliação de impacto algorítmico serão públicas, observados os segredos industrial e comercial, nos termos de regulamento.

obligations.summary: AI agents that learn after market placement of an unexpected and relevant risk to people's rights must notify the sectoral authority and other agents in the chain immediately, and notify affected persons where necessary.

evidence.quote: tiverem conhecimento de risco ou impacto inesperado e relevante que o sistema apresente a direitos de pessoas naturais comunicarão o fato imediatamente à autoridade setorial

obligations.summary: AI agents must report serious security incidents (risk to life or physical integrity, disruption of critical infrastructure, serious property or environmental damage, serious violations of fundamental rights, information integrity or the democratic process) to the sectoral authority.
obligations.applies_from: When the sectoral authority sets the deadline and severity criteria (Art. 42 §1); not before 730 days after publication
obligations.conditional_on: Sectoral authority defines the reporting deadline and severity criteria

evidence.quote: O agente de IA comunicará, em prazo a ser estabelecido, à autoridade setorial a ocorrência de grave incidente de segurança

obligations.summary: Developers of general-purpose and generative AI systems must document development and carry out a preliminary assessment of expected risk levels, including potential systemic risk.
obligations.conditional_on: Competent authority may simplify or waive the obligations of Section V (Art. 33)

evidence.quote: O desenvolvedor de sistemas de IA de propósito geral e generativa deverá realizar, além da documentação pertinente sobre o desenvolvimento do sistema, sua avaliação preliminar

obligations.summary: Before commercial release, developers of general-purpose and generative AI with systemic risk must describe the model, document tests and analyses of foreseeable risks, document residual unmitigable risks, and provide technical documentation and instructions for downstream agents; applies also to open-source and API distribution.

evidence.quote: O desenvolvedor de sistemas de IA de propósito geral e generativa com risco sistêmico, deve, antes de sua disponibilização ou introdução no mercado para fins comerciais, garantir o cumprimento dos seguintes requisitos

obligations.summary: Developers of general-purpose and generative AI with systemic risk must publish a summary of the training dataset.

evidence.quote: publicar resumo do conjunto de dados utilizados no treinamento do sistema, nos termos de regulamentação

obligations.summary: Developers of general-purpose and generative AI with systemic risk may process only datasets collected and processed lawfully and under adequate data governance, especially personal data under the LGPD.

evidence.quote: processar e incorporar apenas conjuntos de dados coletados e tratados em conformidade com as exigências legais e sujeitos a uma adequada governança de dados

obligations.summary: Developers of general-purpose and generative AI with systemic risk must design systems, following applicable standards, to reduce energy and resource use and waste and increase energy efficiency.

evidence.quote: reduzir a utilização de energia, a utilização de recursos e os resíduos, bem como para aumentar a eficiência energética e a eficiência global do sistema

obligations.summary: Developers of general-purpose and generative AI offered to third parties (e.g., via API) must cooperate with downstream agents for risk mitigation and compliance with rights while the service is provided.

evidence.quote: como aqueles fornecidos por meio de API ou outros modelos de integração, devem cooperar, na medida de sua participação, com os demais agentes de IA

obligations.summary: CADE may order developers to grant access to training, validation and test datasets of high-risk AI systems when investigating concrete indications of infringements of the economic order.
obligations.conditional_on: CADE investigation of concrete indications of antitrust infringement

evidence.quote: o Cade poderá ordenar aos desenvolvedores que seja concedido acesso aos conjuntos de dados de treinamento, validação e teste utilizados para o desenvolvimento dos sistemas de IA de alto risco

obligations.summary: Public and private entities must prioritise AI systems and applications aimed at energy efficiency and rational use of natural resources.
obligations.applies_from: On publication (Chapter X Section III, Art. 80 §2 II)

evidence.quote: Entidades públicas e privadas devem priorizar a utilização de sistemas e aplicações de IA que visem à eficiência energética e à racionalização do consumo de recursos naturais.

obligations.summary: AI developers that use copyright-protected content must publish, on an accessible website, a summary of the protected content used in development (mining, training, retraining, testing, validation, application).
obligations.applies_from: On publication (Art. 80 §1 III, immediate effect of Art. 62)

evidence.quote: O desenvolvedor de IA que utilizar conteúdo protegido por direitos de autor e conexos deverá informar sobre os conteúdos protegidos utilizados nos processos de desenvolvimento dos sistemas de IA, por meio da publicação de sumário

obligations.summary: Text and data mining of protected content for AI research and development by scientific, research and educational organisations, museums, public archives and libraries is not infringement if access was lawful, non-commercial and proportionate; copies must be stored securely and only as long as needed, and works may not be displayed or disseminated. Excludes institutions linked to for-profit AI providers.

evidence.quote: Não constitui ofensa aos direitos de autor e conexos a utilização automatizada de conteúdos protegidos em processos de mineração de textos e dados para os fins de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de sistemas de IA

obligations.summary: Rightholders may prohibit the use of their content in AI development outside the Art. 63 exception; AI agents remain liable for damages for use after such prohibition.

evidence.quote: O titular de direitos de autor e conexos poderá proibir a utilização dos conteúdos de sua titularidade no desenvolvimento de sistemas de IA nas hipóteses não contempladas pelo art. 63 desta Lei.

obligations.summary: AI agents that use protected content in mining, training or development must remunerate rightholders, with collective or direct negotiation and remuneration reflecting reasonableness, proportionality, the agent's size and competitive effects; due only to rightholders domiciled in Brazil or in reciprocal countries.
obligations.conditional_on: Rightholder is Brazilian or foreign domiciled in Brazil, or domiciled in a country granting reciprocity (Art. 65 §1)

evidence.quote: O agente de IA que utilizar conteúdos protegidos por direitos de autor e conexos em processos de mineração, treinamento ou desenvolvimento de sistemas de IA deve remunerar os titulares desses conteúdos em virtude dessa utilização

obligations.summary: Use by AI systems of images, audio, voice or video depicting or identifying natural persons must respect personality rights under the Civil Code.

evidence.quote: A utilização de conteúdos de imagem, áudio, voz ou vídeo que retratem ou identifiquem pessoas naturais pelos sistemas de IA deverá respeitar os direitos da personalidade

obligations.summary: Public authorities developing, contracting or adopting high-risk AI must ensure access to databases and full data portability, and minimum standardisation of data architecture for interoperability.

evidence.quote: Ao desenvolver, contratar ou adotar os sistemas de IA de alto risco, o poder público deve garantir

obligations.summary: All public administration bodies (and public-service concessionaires, and the Legislative and Judiciary in administrative functions) using high-risk AI must log who used the system and why, guarantee explanation and human review of decisions with relevant legal effects, and publish preliminary assessments.
obligations.applies_from: 730 days after publication (Art. 80 caput); existing systems within a period set by the competent authority (Art. 23 §4)

evidence.quote: todos os entes da Administração Pública direta e indireta, ao desenvolver ou utilizar sistemas de IA de alto risco, adotarão as seguintes medidas

obligations.summary: Public use of biometric systems for identification must be preceded by an algorithmic impact assessment; a system whose risks cannot be eliminated or substantially mitigated must be discontinued.

evidence.quote: A utilização de sistemas biométricos para fins de identificação deverá observar os princípios e as medidas de governança previstos nesta Lei e será precedida de avaliação de impacto algorítmico

obligations.summary: The federal Executive must set minimum transparency standards for AI systems used by federal public bodies and monitor compliance.

evidence.quote: Caberá ao Poder Executivo federal fixar padrões mínimos de transparência para os sistemas de IA utilizados por órgãos e entidades do setor público federal

obligations.summary: The SIA must regulate the list of high-risk AI systems and identify new high-risk uses on stated criteria, after social participation and regulatory impact analysis; the competent authority publishes the consolidated list and sectoral authorities set sector lists and receive impact assessments.

evidence.quote: Caberá ao SIA regulamentar a classificação da lista dos sistemas de IA de alto risco, bem como identificar novas hipóteses de aplicação de alto risco

obligations.summary: As SIA coordinator, the competent authority (ANPD) must represent Brazil internationally, issue binding general norms (information disclosure, impact assessment procedures, incident reporting), receive anonymous complaints and publish annual reports; it is the residual regulator where no sectoral regulator exists.

evidence.quote: expedir, em colaboração com os demais integrantes do SIA, normas vinculantes de caráter geral sobre os seguintes temas

obligations.summary: Sectoral authorities exercise regulatory, supervisory and sanctioning powers over AI in their sectors, issue specific rules including for high-risk activities, and supervise governance measures for systems they classify as high-risk.

evidence.quote: exercer competência regulatória, fiscalizatória e sancionatória, conforme sua esfera de competência outorgada por lei, para desenvolvimento, implementação e uso de sistemas de IA

obligations.summary: SIA bodies must immediately pass to CADE any information found during supervision that may be relevant to competition law enforcement.

evidence.quote: Os órgãos e entidades integrantes do SIA devem comunicar imediatamente ao Conselho Administrativo de Defesa Econômica (Cade) quaisquer informações identificadas no decurso das atividades de fiscalização

obligations.summary: The competent authority must create and maintain a publicly accessible database of high-risk AI containing the public documents of impact assessments.

evidence.quote: Cabe à autoridade competente, em colaboração com as autoridades setoriais, a criação e a manutenção de base de dados de IA de alto risco, acessível ao público

obligations.summary: The competent authority must regulate, after public consultation and regulatory impact analysis, the procedure and criteria for administrative sanctions and publish dosimetry methodologies.

evidence.quote: A autoridade competente definirá, por meio de regulamento próprio, o procedimento de apuração e os critérios de aplicação das sanções administrativas a infrações a esta Lei

obligations.summary: The competent authority and sectoral authorities must promote and authorise AI regulatory sandboxes, regulate their procedures, and may waive rules under their competence for participants.

evidence.quote: A autoridade competente e as autoridades setoriais que compõem o SIA deverão promover e autorizar o funcionamento de ambiente regulatório experimental para inovação em inteligência artificial (sandbox regulatório de IA)

obligations.summary: The competent authority, sectoral authorities and Cria, with the Ministry of Labour, must develop guidelines to mitigate negative impacts of AI on workers (job displacement), enhance positive impacts, value collective bargaining and foster training.

evidence.quote: em cooperação com o Ministério do Trabalho, deverão desenvolver diretrizes para, entre outros objetivos

Public bodies are named in institutional roles: ANPD as the competent authority coordinating the SIA (Art. 45 §1 I), CADE (Arts. 49, 52), the Ministry of Labour (Art. 58), the Ministry of Environment and Climate Change (Art. 61); Cria and Cecia are created (Arts. 53-54).

notes: Text-internal issues: (1) numbering jumps from Art. 30 to Art. 32 (no Art. 31); (2) Arts. 38 and 57 are near-identical (sandbox participants' liability), as are Art. 49 §§3-4 and Art. 52 (CADE); (3) Art. 1 §2 and Art. 73 both mandate simplified regimes, with different lists (Art. 73 adds national promotion and PPP/ICT projects and excludes GPAI under Ch. IV Sec. V). Staggered entry into force (Art. 80): prohibitions, GPAI and copyright rules at 180 days; Art. 62 and the institutional chapter (Ch. IX except Art. 50) on publication; everything else, including sanctions, at 730 days. No numeric compute, parameter, user or revenue threshold defines 'systemic risk' or the GPAI regime; high-risk status depends on the Art. 14 list and SIA regulation (Art. 15). Preliminary assessment is voluntary for AI agents generally (Art. 12, 'poderá') but mandatory for GPAI developers (Art. 29). The autógrafo is signed 'Senado Federal, em 31 de janeiro de 2025'.
